tournament.name: BCDL Win-A-Mox Diamond - Buffalo Chicken Dip Legacy

decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then reanimating them for a quick win. It utilizes cards like Entomb and Reanimate to put creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play as early as possible, while also running disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo. The deck aims to outpace opponents by utilizing the powerful synergy between its combo pieces and efficient card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize Mystic Forge in combination with cards like Voltaic Key, Grim Monolith, and other artifacts to generate significant value and card advantage. By assembling the right pieces, the deck aims to create explosive plays and chain together combos that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. With cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms providing additional support and control elements, the deck seeks to establish a dominant board presence and pull off game-winning moves in a Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on utilizing Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to create a powerful combo that allows for massive card draw and potential win conditions. The deck also includes protection cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. The addition of Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and other creature support helps to provide additional value and versatility to the deck. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and ensure consistent access to different colors of mana.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Nadu, Winged Wisdom and other creatures with abilities that can be activated for free. By utilizing cards like Shaman en-Kor and Nomads en-Kor to protect Nadu and generate infinite mana with Gaea's Cradle and untap effects, the deck can quickly ramp into powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth. The deck also includes various tutors like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to consistently find key pieces of the combo, while also including cards like Endurance for protection and disruption against opposing strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Nomads en-Kor, Cephalid Illusionist, and either Narcomoeba or Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck is built around using various spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the combo pieces quickly, while also including interaction like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The addition of Urza's Saga provides additional consistency and value, making the deck a versatile and powerful force in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will, it aims to control the board and protect its threats. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps filter through the deck for key cards, while Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf provide a clock for the opponent. The deck also incorporates removal spells like Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is built around Underground Sea and Wasteland to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of creatures like Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to create powerful synergy and generate card advantage. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to control the game early on with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and counter magic before assembling its combo pieces to win the game efficiently. The mana base is designed to support the deck's various colors and ensure consistency in casting its spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Doomsday card to set up a winning combination using cards like Thassa's Oracle and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. It includes a variety of card draw spells and counterspells to control the game and protect the combo. The deck also includes mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond to help cast Doomsday quickly. Teferi, Time Raveler is included to provide additional disruption and protection for the combo. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single turn.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, efficient removal in Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, and powerful counter spells in Force of Will. The deck also plays a variety of threats like Snapcaster Mage and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent while controlling the board. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three colors, allowing for flexibility in casting spells of different colors. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Mystic Forge to churn out powerful artifacts quickly, while also employing key support cards like Grim Monolith and Urza's Saga to generate mana and search for necessary cards. The goal is to assemble a strong board presence, control the game with artifacts like The One Ring and Karn, the Great Creator, and ultimately win through a combination of synergistic interactions and powerful artifacts. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, synergy, and raw power from its array of artifacts and combo potential.

The main concept of this deck is to cheat out powerful and game-winning creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath by using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. The deck aims to quickly set up an overwhelming board state and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Cunning Wish allows for both card selection and protection, while the use of Stock Up and Lórien Revealed provides additional searching and resource manipulation. Ultimately, the deck is focused on quickly assembling its combo pieces and closing out the game.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and cheat big, powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play through the use of cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. A key aspect of this deck is the ability to tutor for specific cards using Cunning Wish and Intuition, while also maintaining card advantage through Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the interaction between Goblin Engineer, Painter's Servant, and Grindstone to quickly mill the opponent's library and win the game. This combo provides a powerful win condition that can be set up relatively quickly with the help of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Goblin Welder. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to protect the combo and control the opponent's spells, while also using mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to speed up the process.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of low-cost spells and creatures. By utilizing efficient card draw and counterspells, the deck aims to control the pace of the game while applying pressure with evasive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The mana base is streamlined to maximize consistency and allow for easy access to all colors. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption, leading to a quick and decisive victory.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. It aims to control the tempo of the game by quickly deploying threats and using cheap interaction to protect them. The deck utilizes efficient spells like Brainstorm, Lightning Bolt, and Force of Will to maintain an advantage while applying pressure. Additionally, it aims to maximize card selection and manipulation with cards like Mishra's Bauble, Ponder, and Preordain. Overall, the deck aims to win through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells.
